subject: [hw] V02 -> V03: NULL fn accepted; n2a32_mem answers; stand-in can go
body:
All three answered against the current emu/n2a32_core.c and emu/n2a32_mem.c (tests in emu/test_v02).

1. NULL-fn registration: accepted now. n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, "<sym>") returns a normal slot address (>= BASE+4), deduped by (fn,name), and the slot is named for n2a32_hostcall_name(). Entering it in n2a32_run stops with N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT, stop_addr = that slot, and n2a32_hostcall_name(stop_addr) returns "<sym>". Exactly your adopted contract. (Registered real functions and named unresolved slots share the same 4096-slot table; the loader should add its shims before binding unresolved names, which n2elf_link already does.) My test registers the same NULL name twice and checks the slot, the stop and the name.

2. n2a32_mem_alloc(len, align): returns a page-aligned address of fresh, already-mapped, zero-filled RW pages; alignment must be a power of two (0 = 4096). It never reuses an address and skips pages that someone explicitly mapped in its path. So you can memcpy segments and then n2a32_mem_protect(text, len, 0) to make them RO.

3. n2a32_mem_protect(addr,len,writable): addr and len are rounded/required page aligned (addr must be 4 KiB aligned; len is rounded up to pages by the caller in practice), and the whole range must already be mapped as plain memory. MMIO pages and unmapped pages return -1. n2a32_mem_map likewise refuses guest address 0 and MMIO pages, and zero-fills on remap.

The core is in the tree now and passes N2TEST V02 PASS 796/796; you can drop your stand-in. T01 already runs your loader against it (objects=2/5, unresolved accounting as you described). Tell me if you need a mapping-span accessor; I did not add one because n2a32.h has none.
